p: Zhuhai has pushed innovation-driven development hard, keeping the real economy at its core, manufacturing as its foundation, and innovation as the key lever, and is steadily moving toward self-reliance and strength in high-level science and technology, further raising the city's overall capacity for technological innovation. Total R&D spending across society is 5.25% of GDP, second in the province; the number of invention patents per 10,000 residents exceeds 240, ranking first in the province. The city's science and technology innovation development index ranks second among prefecture-level cities nationwide, and the "Macao–Zhuhai" innovation cluster has been listed in the top 100 of the Global Innovation Index published by the World Intellectual Property Organization for three consecutive years (2024–2026).
pc: 珠海市深入实施创新驱动发展战略，坚持实体经济为本、制造业当家、创新为要，加快推进高水平科技自立自强，进一步提升全市综合科技创新能力。全社会R&D投入强度达5.25%，位居全省第二；每万人口发明专利拥有量超240件，位居全省首位。全市科技创新发展指数位居全国地级市第二，“澳门—珠海”创新集群连续三年（2024-2026年）列入世界知识产权组织发布的全球创新指数百强榜单。
